Bengaluru City Traffic Police has issued route diversions for smooth movement during the Eid Milad processions:

📍 SJP Road to Old Udaya TV Junction – 2 PM to 12 Midnight

Procession routes will be closed for vehicular traffic. Alternative routes have been provided—commuters are requested to follow diversions and plan travel accordingly.

🙏 Your cooperation ensures a safe and peaceful celebration.
